programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy wakes up after a nap, starving, but the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread is empty. The cupboards are barren, except for a package of chocolate powder. Grizzy has the idea of mixing it with coconut milk. It's absolutely delicious! But the Lemmings, who are every bit as gluttonous, want their share of the choco-coco drink!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy gets a nice big bite on the end of his fishing line. While he concentrates hard to strike his catch, the Lemmings divert the fish to tow them on a kite. Grizzy tries to sabotage their improvised kitesurfing game to recover what's rightfully his, until a shark's fin appears on the horizon!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The cupboards of the log cabin are hopelessly empty and Grizzy's belly is rumbling. Through his binoculars, he observes the overexcited Lemmings slipping all sorts of small metal objects into the slot of… a Yummy vending machine!?! The bear joins them on the pontoon. If only they could find some coins to make the machine work. Maybe the solution is to find the booty indicated on the treasure map they unearthed on the beach?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After accidentally breaking his favorite sofa, Grizzy spots a cozy fishing cabin on a neighboring island. He requisitions the Lemmings' canoe to get there but discovers that the new cabin is dilapidated and lacking all comfort. The poor bear had been deluded by a poster. However, a fabulous yacht is moored nearby. It catches both his attention and that of the Lemmings, who have just disembarked on the island!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun taking potshots at sand statues depicting Grizzy. Outraged, he catapults them far into the distance. Grizzy takes advantage of their absence to erect a monumental sculpture of himself. But just as he takes a selfie in front of the sculpture, Grizzy realizes that the Lemmings have laid hands on… a pirate cannon!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After being hit over the head, the Lemmings become hypnotized by a fitness poster and take themselves for sports coaches. They are determined to forcefully train Grizzy, who would much rather lounge around than do push-ups and squats. But the Lemmings' new personality makes them particularly overbearing.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Nothing seems to be biting Grizzy's fishing rod and the bear is in despair. Suddenly he spots a fabulous swordfish swimming in the lagoon. The bear is already licking his chops, when he sees the Lemmings straddling the fish in a rodeo game. From inside the cabin he uses as a mooring post, Grizzy manages to snare the swordfish and is about to pull it in, but the Lemmings are riding it toward the high seas. Each party tugs hard. And the cabin starts to slide…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that several drops of Tabasco sauce poured into a rock fault releases powerful sprays of steam that propel them high into the sky on a pot lid. Except that the entire volcanic island shudders each time the drops are poured. Grizzy, who has decided to take a nap in his hammock, confiscates the bottle before realizing that the Lemmings have an entire stock !

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have decided to organize a race with two sand yachts they found on the beach. The only thing missing, is a worthy adversary. They put Grizzy, who was taking a nap, on one of the yachts without waking him up. And the race is off. Grizzy wakes up in shock onboard his sand yacht.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy has run out of ideas to open his coconut until he sees the Lemmings' new friend the crab open one with a simple snip of the claw. He confiscates the crustacean and uses it to take the tops off his coconuts. As they fight over the crab, the characters discover a remote-control device in a secret grotto that operates a giant crab. Grizzy takes over the controls, but the Lemmings want to play with the joystick too!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: A helicopter takes off from the beach, leaving behind installations for a TV game, namely lots of food supplies – which are locked up. To access the keys and the food, participants must win team tests under the surveillance of a drone. The Lemmings are the yellow team. The red team is comprised of Grizzy, an oar, and a flabbergasted crab!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock – Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive – but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Fed up of driving Mrs Wicket everywhere, Mr Bean decides to teach her how to drive. He sets up a practice “car” in his flat using tin cans as pedals and household objects for all the levers. Mrs Wicket does so well that Mr Bean lets her have a proper lesson in his beloved car – but Mrs Wicket gets carried away in the real car, and it’s a white-knuckle ride!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Moley and his mom enter Mishmosh’s yearly science fair while the Gardener and Squirm plot to snag Manny.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: A musical tribute to Ace, the super-brave bat-hound!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 1
programme.desc: Chep is very excited: tonight, a rare and extremely stinky plant is going to bloom! But he already promised Mush-Mush to play their favourite game. When he chooses the flower instead, Mush-Mush is angry and the two friends stop talking. But when Mush-Mush realises that Chep is about to miss the blooming, he decides he won’t let that happen and helps his friend!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 1
programme.desc: When Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit take their compost meals back to their home-tree to eat, they think they have made a great new discovery – compost to go! They set up a delivery service so everyone can eat at home too. It’s so cool! Except Sushi-Mushi misses hosting everyone at the Food Snail, and everyone starts missing eating together…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 1
programme.desc: Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit are playing dares and having a lot fun. All the Mushables are happy for them except Fung and Miff who keep mocking them. When Mush-Mush reply they should play together to see how fun it is, Fung and Miff accept. Mush-Mush surprisingly gets along with Fung and Miff... until one dare too many.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 1
programme.desc: Mush-Mush wants to be just like Starmush when he grows up, because he’s convinced that Starmush is the most awesome Mushable there is and that his daily life must be extraordinary. So, Mush-Mush trails Starmush, which soon annoys the Mushelder. To get rid of Mush-Mush, Starmush decides to live up to the Mushler’s fantasies…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 1
programme.desc: Chep has come across a new seedpod specimen. Mushpot warns him not to take it though. But the temptation is too much and Chep can’t resist taking the seedpod and opening it… to find it is full of itchy powder! Argh! Mush-Mush and Lilit do their best to help their friend, but it seems like the only way Chep can get rid of the itching is to ask Mushpot for a remedy…

programme.desc: It's the battle of the moustaches when Tom accidentally drinks a hair tonic potion left behind by Jerry – and Butch realizes he needs to acquire some facial hair of his own if he is to compete for Toodles and Dollface's attentions.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: An evil ringmaster recruits Tom to help him snare the Catsylvania mice.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun bouncing off the backs of green frogs while Grizzy chases some mosquitos buzzing around him. Displeased, the rodents replace Grizzy's green frogs with poisonous orange ones that paralyze anyone who touches them!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy comes home and discovers the Lemmings dancing madly and throws them into the jungle where they meet a parrot that can reproduce any sound. The bird becomes their ally to distract Grizzy and recover their musical equipment.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize an obstacle course in their cabin. Grizzy ejects the Lemmings from the cabin and they crash onto an Incan temple where they discover a spheric object that can control the Earth's rotation.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: During a great Parasaur family migration, the Ranchers spot trouble. The youngest, Sneezer, is under the weather with booming sneezes that startle even himself, causing him to bolt away in panic! Min manages to calm him down just in time! Confident, Min volunteers to nurse Sneezer back to health while also taking on Uncle Jack's HQ duties. But caring for dinos is no easy feat, especially alone!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: First impressions can be tricky, especially when a protective mama sea turtle mistakes the Jungle Jetter for a predator! The frightened mother is injured in a chase, leaving the Dino Ranchers rushing to her rescue! Back at HQ, Min carefully treats the mama's wounds while the others watch over her tiny hatchlings, safely tucked inside a pen! But one mischievous baby, Shelly, has other plans!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Against his better judgement, Bean has agreed to go out on a proper date with Irma Gobb, his girlfriend. She has the perfect evening planned: a romantic film followed by a candlelit dinner for two. If only she had the perfect boyfriend to go with it.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mistaken for an escaped convict, Bean is carted off to jail where he finds that, with a little imagination, prison can be quite nice actually. The real convict finds life less cosy under the thumb of Mr. Bean’s landlady.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: As the storm rages, Baby Owl's tree is struck by lightning! She's left without a nest. The Baby Lemmings seek shelter from the wind, and find refuge in a crumbling cave. They decide to decorate it in a makeover style. Unintentionally, they take the items Baby Owl had prepared for her new nest. She comes to get them back, but the Baby Lemmings don't understand why.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Today, Baby Raccoon has decided to iron all the tree leaves in the forest so that they lie flat, and pile them up in a neat heap. This new obsession allows the Baby Lemmings to discover the joys of origami. But there's a lot of failure in the Baby Lemmings' work, as they leave the crumpled leaves on the ground, unknowingly destroying Baby Raccoon's work.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings knock down one of Baby Beaver's constructions, bowling style. He immediately gets angry and sends the lemmings off to play further away. But he soon runs out of branches for his construction. While he is looking for new ones, he notices that the Baby Lemmings have collected all the beautiful branches in the area to build a natural bowling alley! Baby beaver wants to take their branches, but the Baby Lemmings won't let him!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Music Meister is stealing the singing voices of all the people in Gotham. Now it's up to bashful Buff to gain confidence in his voice and use it to take down Music Meister.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: When Batwing's favorite Bat-Net gets ripped during a chase with Riddler, she must learn to let go of her old net (despite it being her favorite) if she's going to help Batman stop the Riddler in his tracks.

programme.title: Ben 10 - Season 3
programme.desc: When Ben and family go to London to visit the legendary Big Ben, the Bugg Brothers are there to greet them, with yet another outrageously over the top plan of course: to shrink the Big Ben bell in order to steal it!

programme.title: Ben 10 - Season 3
programme.desc: While visiting China, Ben, Gwen and Grandpa Max take a trek to the Great Wall but their adventure is nearly ruined by daredevils LaGrange and Vin Ethanol trying to jump the international monument. Ben must hop into the Rustbuggy to chase away the fast and furious foes.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is unimpressed with a horror movie he sees at the cinema and reckons he can do much better. Bean sets out to create his very own home movie masterpiece –featuring Mrs Wicket Irma and Teddy! The screening in the garden is a huge success but will Mrs Wicket be pleased with her makeover and starring role?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean has to look after Mrs Wicket’s pet goldfish while she is away. With a ravenous Scrapper sniffing around Bean ends up becoming more bodyguard than babysitter. But when he manages to lose his fishy friend Mr Bean takes a nightmare journey down the sewer and back to his neighbour’s house via the park. Can Mr Bean get the pesky pet back in the bowl before Mrs Wicket returns home?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean wins two tickets for an exotic cruise and naturally he takes Teddy along for the trip of a lifetime. Once aboard the huge ocean liner Mr Bean soon settles into a life of luxury but while showing off to a new friend Bean becomes ‘man overboard’ and stranded on a dessert island. The hungrier he gets the wilder he becomes and desperate to find a way off the island.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: It's the First Day of Spring and Mr. Bean sets about washing his clothes, his furniture, his teddy and himself. But, alas, there’s no hot water! A bit of inventive improvisation with an outside drainpipe proves Mr. Bean to be greener at D.I.Y. plumbing than he thought.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Fred switches places with Jeff, the tour guide at a history museum, to give him a chance to lead the Gang in solving a mystery. The mystery: a frightening Egyptian crocodile deity is terrorizing the museum. The problem: Fred is instantly jealous of this new guy and sets out to solve the mystery before Jeff can - with the help of Jeff's tour group of children!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Shaggy and Scooby's favorite chef is finally opening his own restaurant but a monstrous Yeti threatens the opening night. The gang has to solve the mystery before dessert is served, while Shaggy and Scooby have to resist eating all the food that's meant for the customers!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings’ hard rock concert is driving Grizzy mad. After kicking them out, Grizzy requisitions their ghetto blaster and listens to a relaxation cassette to calm down. The Lemmings discover an ancestral tree whose engraved strips of bark cast targeted maledictions. To recover their material, the Lemmings decide to drive Grizzy out by cursing him with the Ten Plaques of the Savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine, Grizzy decides to redo the cabin’s interior design. To make sure everything is perfect, he ousts the Lemmings and their electric train. By chance, the Lemmings discover an underground futuristic premises in the middle of the savanna. From this secret place, they can see the entire savanna on a giant screen, down to the very inside of Grizzy’s cabin just like in a sandbox video game. By using the menus, they can have an impact on reality and thus... on Grizzy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a magic stick that functions as a Yummy divining rod. Grizzy steals their stick and finds a Yummy deposit in the savanna. To take control over Grizzy’s discovery, the Lemmings set a trap to draw the bear far from the deposit and transform it into an industrial chocolate factory. Grizzy will want to recover his chocolate deposit.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: An eclipse prevents the solar panels from supplying the cabin with electricity and Grizzy is disgruntledbecause he can’t watch TV. When he discovers that the Lemmings are using fireflies to have a party withoutelectricity, Grizzy evicts the Lemmings and recovers the fireflies to fuel the solar panels. The Lemmingshappen upon a jewel that gives them total control over the fireflies.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings recover a jar of Yummy from an automatic distributor but before they can enjoy it Grizzy confiscates the treat. In exchange, he leaves them the keyring that came as a gift. The Lemmings aren’t interested until the keyring lands in a magic vial which gives it an extraordinary power: stick the keyring onto any object and it will shrink to the size of a plastic miniature figurine!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy is jealous of the Lemmings’ new game: an interactive dance mat connected to the TV where the idea is to jump around and perform dance sequences. As they fight over the mat, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a hidden mechanism in one of the Great Wall of China’s watchtowers. The mechanism activates a game on the wall’s paving stones that is similar to the interactive mat, only life size. On your marks, get ready, dance!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is on a photography jaunt in the countryside snapping the normal everyday wildlife – a fox a bird a dinosaur! A DINOSAUR?!! Mr Bean is terrified until he realises what fame and fortune it could bring him. Does he get the photograph of a lifetime or is the situation not quite as it seems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean accidently causes Mrs Wicket to be hospitalised and in need of a wheelchair. Back home Mr Bean has thoughtfully set up a bell service so that he can be at Mrs Wicket’s beck and call at any time of day or night. Mrs Wicket likes this...a lot. The bell doesn’t stop ringing and an exhausted Mr Bean finds himself running up and down the stairs carrying and fetching until he eventually loses patience with his patient.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s car has broken down and he is late to meet Irma for a night at the opera. Mr Bean finally arrives but he is refused entry to the theatre because of his filthy attire. Forced to borrow some clothes from the local launderette Bean is mistaken for the star of the show and ends up on the stage giving the operatic performance of a lifetime.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes a taxi to his local toyshop but a dodgy cabbie thinks he can take Mr Bean for a ride. After a mix up Mr Bean finds himself driving the taxi and starts to have fun couriering people to their destinations even giving an American tourist an extensive tour of London. But will the taxi driver find out what’s been going on and how much will Bean’s final fare be?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Conned by a mechanic into believing his beloved car to be beyond repair, Mr. Bean reluctantly consigns his faithful four-wheeled friend to the car crusher. After choosing hot-air ballooning as an alternative mode of transport, he spots his cherished car from the air… with the unscrupulous mechanic whistling at the wheel! This discovery raises more than Mr. Bean’s spirits.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s the middle of the night and Tom plays makeshift instruments creating loud music that wakes up Jerry. Jerry tries to put an end to Tom's concert with no success. Tuffy wakes up and goes along with the music. Jerry decides to join in on the fun.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Music Meister is stealing the singing voices of all the people in Gotham. Now it's up to bashful Buff to gain confidence in his voice and use it to take down Music Meister.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: When Batman teams up with Aquaman to stop a sinister undersea plot, the Batwheels are excited to use their new cool underwater mode!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: In this country-inspired music video, Buff the Bat-Truck shows off his strength as he tows the bad guys out of town and lifts the spirits of his fellow Batwheels with his sensitive side, all while protecting the people (and critters) of Gotham.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred lives out his childhood dream of being a stage magician as he and the gang go uncover at a private magic club being terrorized by a mutant Rabbit monster!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang travels back to Ancient Greece, where they play unique roles in a Greek Mystery involving the mythological spider woman, Arachne, and her attempts to disrupt the royal wedding that would unite two great cities!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry is raiding the fridge but gets caught by Tom. Tom tries to get the food back, but Jerry and Tuffy fight back by throwing food at Tom. Jerry accidentally throws Tuffy at Tom and has to rescue him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings, who are both starving, discover a temple dedicated to an ancestral brioche. According to the book lying open inside the temple, to obtain a perfect brioche you must gather three gold ingredients and set them on the altar. When the panda idol who guards the temple receives the offering, the person will receive his favorite food in abundance. Grizzy and Lemmings set out to find the sacred ingredients but there is no question of working together. May the best critter win!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: An integrated circuit containing an artificial intelligence accidentally connects to Grizzy’s stuffed teddy bear, which comes to life like a modern-day Pinocchio. Grizzy educates the chip until it decides to connect to the Lemmings’ robot to play with them. When the AI becomes a teenager, it is no longer interested in either Grizzy or the Lemmings and prefers using a smartphone to keep learning. Grizzy and the Lemmings join efforts to try and reset the chip’s memory and relive its childhood phase over and over.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a large silkworm that produces an extremely soft and resilient elastic thread ad infinitum. The Lemmings consider the worm the ideal game companion, but Grizzy needs the worm to make his knitwear. To become masters of the silkworm, the close enemies will go to harsh extremes.

programme.title: Ben 10 - Season 3
programme.desc: When a mysterious electrical storm downs the Omni-Copter at the Equator, Team Tennyson soon discovers Solar and Polar are behind it.

programme.title: Ben 10 - Season 3
programme.desc: While taking in the sights and sounds of a Rio de Jenaro music festival, Ben bristles at Gwen's suggestion that she be his new sidekick, as the festival is threaten by the supersonic sound waves of Lord Decibel.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Miguel is having one of those days! After finally tracking down Jack's missing harmonica, he barely has time to celebrate before Big Rex ambushes him, and a Compy makes off with the harmonica! And his day only gets worse from there! Sinking sand, man-eating plants, giant ants and volcano tremors only increases Miguel's fear of the jungle -- all of which he must overcome in order to save the day!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: When Bessie the Bronto takes a nasty tumble, her foot is injured. The pain has turned the gentle giant into a thrashing, dangerous dino who won't let anyone near her, not even Min! According to Jack, rare water plants called lazypads can calm even the most riled-up dinosaur! Jack, Min, and Clover hop into the Jungle Jetter and dive beneath the waves in search of the elusive plants!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean finds himself babysitting a baboon.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean fancies a game of golf so he creates his own golf course inside his flat and invites Irma to join him for a round. Their somewhat eccentric game takes them from sitting room to bathroom and through Mrs Wicket’s flat as they battle to be the winner of the First Bean Open Championship.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Who's afraid of daft films about giant killer cats, blobs from outer space and thumb-size men who dance around in sugar bowls? Mr. Bean is. He's very afraid. A trip to the cinema makes Mr. Bean’s imagination play tricks on him.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover they can play spinning top with nuts. Baby Lynx sets out to beat the lemmings at their game by making herself a big spinning top that can destroy the lemmings' spinning tops. The defeated baby lemmings then find a huge stone top, but just as they're about to play with it, Baby Lynx returns and challenges their mega top.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Raccoon has set about clearing the forest of everything in sight: bark, pine cones, twigs.... But the Baby Lemmings are using all these elements to make increasingly incredible domino courses! When Baby Raccoon discovers this, he just feels they've made a mess of the forest again, and decides to pick it up despite the Baby Lemmings' annoyance.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose has a passion for little blue mushrooms (which look like a baby lemming lying on its belly), which he searches for like a truffle-hunting dog. But the baby lemmings, after seeing a butterfly disguised as a leaf, decide that day to play hide-and-seek. So when Baby Moose thinks he's going to find some mushrooms, the baby lemmings jump out of their hiding place. Baby Moose gets scared every time and decides to put an end to the baby lemmings' game.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs is running late to catch his flight but first must get past a toll tree in dire need of an attitude adjustment.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and a Snowman fight over who should get the carrot.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Wile get skunked. Who has the better way to recover from such a smelly situation? It's nature versus SCIENCE! May the best man win!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: A Ghost visits Bugs and battles him for his bedsheet.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Scooby runs into an old kennel mate Axel who is a highly trained Police dog who thinks mystery of the Junk yard monster is too big a case for the gang.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: When a video game company tries to buy an old algorithm from Velma and convince her to work for them in San Francisco, the gang becomes embroiled in the mystery of a video game villain who has seemingly come to life, the Ghost Chef.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: After a head-on collision with the milkman, Mr. Bean’s landlady is rushed to hospital, leaving him to look after her odious one-eyed cat Scrapper. Fur isn’t the only thing that flies and in the end it’s Bean that needs looking after.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in the library studying his family heritage. Someone brings to his attention Mr Bean’s resemblance to a certain Lord Bean. Mr Bean sets off to track down his ancestral home (a castle) in Scotland where he is welcomed with open arms. But owning a castle is not cheap. Can Mr Bean escape before he runs out of money and has there been a case of mistaken identity?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry are hired by Dixie Wolf to find all the sheep that've gone missing.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Frankenstein turns Tom into a colossus and Tom ends up terrorizing the village mice until Jerry Van Mouseling saves the day.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: A guilty conscience causes Butch to change his ways. But Tom, Jerry, Spike and Tuffy quickly decide they like the old Butch better.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with a bowling game they found in the Ranger's storeroom. Grizzy hastens to destroy the pins to ensure his peace and quiet. But the Lemmings discover a remote-control device that can modify the ball's weight. By setting it on maximum, the ball could knock over much more than pins: furniture, a bear and even a log cabin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: After the rains, to the great delight of the Lemmings, strange bouncing mushrooms have sprouted in the yard. To put an end to the Lemmings' noisy games - which prevent Grizzy from enjoying his peace and quiet - Grizzy tramples the mushrooms. Only to realize that each crushed mushroom frees a cloud of spores that instantly creates... a bunch of identical mushrooms.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have laid hand on special magnets which turn any object they are stuck to into flying objects. Grizzy bears the consequences and is ejected out of the cabin on his couch, which has turned into a flying-couch. Upon landing, Grizzy discovers by chance that the magnet stuck to his forehead enables him to fly like Peter Pan.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: With a lion-tamer's whip, a sugar bowl and lots of work, the Lemmings have successfully trained a caribou to go through their obstacle course. Grizzy cannot help but admire the performance. He decides to steal their idea, and the caribou, to create his own circus act and impress his lovely she-bear.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy happens onto the electronic version of the Ranger Lemming toy which is capable of reproducing the movements one teaches it, like a smart robot. Grizzy immediately grasps the potential of a robot that could perform chores with rapidity and precision, but the Lemmings would rather teach it to dance.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Ranger's cabin is equipped with an ultra-effective pest detector capable of sensing the presence of an intruder, then chasing it out by emitting a wave that instructs the creature's brain to leave at once. Grizzy and the Lemmings are no longer able to stay inside, until they discover that the box's remote-control device allows you to select which type of animal will be spared or targeted by the wave.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Hot Hot makes all the food extremely spicy and the accumulated heat threatens to blow up Professor K's volcano.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Kitty is staying over at the Batcave for a sleepover, but getting her to lie down for a catnap is no easy task as the Batwheels have to find creative ways to get her to sleep.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Redbird learns a lesson in asking for permission when he takes one of Buff's stuffed animals without asking. When the stuffed animal accidentally gets swiped by the Legion of Zoom, Redbird will have to rescue the stuffed unicorn or admit to Buff what he did.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: When Bam is covered in super bouncy Bounce X goo during a chase with Prank, he must learn to embrace and use his newfound bouncing abilities to his advantage if he's going to put a stop to Prank's latest scheme.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Bam must learn to adapt and try something new as he’s tasked to dive the Bat Big Rig all the way to Star City, while the Legion of Zoom chases after him.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: As The Looney Builders build Kathy Bat an upside-down radio station, Porky has concerns but doesn’t speak up.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Queen Beatrice hires The Looney Builders to build a workshop in her beehive where there is one rule the crew has trouble following.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Prince Lionel of England hires The Looney Builders to build him a party room for his birthday, then proceeds to boss the crew around.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Penelope Pussycat to build a fashion runway in France where they are encouraged to make their design bigger and more fun.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Halloween, so the crew decorates their garage for the Looneyburg Trick-Or-Treaters.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants an ice cream from the ice cream van. But by the time he gets to the front of the queue the ice-cream man has gone to lunch. Bean takes it upon himself to climb through in an open window and into the back of the van from where he starts to help himself. Unfortunately he soon attracts a crowd and is forced to serve a long queue of kids until all the ice cream runs out. When the ice-cream man comes back from lunch and drives away he is unaware that Bean is still hiding in the back of his van en route to the ice cream factory.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is feeling very left out when he discovers that Mrs Wicket is having a huge party downstairs and apparently he isn’t invited. Bean tries every trick in the book to sneak himself into the party – even resorting to hiding inside an enormous cake. If only he knew the real reason for the celebration.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While trying to avoid the Lemmings' outboard speedboat, Grizzy punctures his air mattress and is propelled into a hidden grotto where he finds a conch decorated with Maori symbols that can control whales. Grizzy returns, proudly straddling his cetacean and chases the Lemmings from his peaceful spot. But the Lemmings' imagination is equal to the size of this potential new playmate!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While arguing over a jar of Yummy, Grizzy and the Lemmings happen upon a polar bear cub who is crying. When the little bear sees them, he wails even louder. Annoyed by his sobs, Grizzy and the rodents try to pacify him, but nothing works. After feeding and changing him, the baby finally falls asleep. How can they pick up their Yummy battle without waking the cub?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: A meteorite falls not far from the cabin. While the Lemmings are sledding outside on a metal pot lid, their sled is abruptly drawn to the extraterrestrial boulder. In seventh heaven, the rodents start over again, this time using the TV satellite dish. But Grizzy, determined to get the dish back at any cost, must confront the magnetism of the meteorite and the fury of the Lemmings, for the rodents are set on playing.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have set up a long line of dominos in the cabin that ends with several giant ice blocks and a rocket outside. Weary of not finding the peace and calm he loves so dearly, Grizzy sabotages the game. The rocket hits an ice block and blows up the cabin. Grizzy gets his hands on a machine that can sculpt ice. The bear dreams of an igloo, but the Lemmings have other projects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings find an ice block outside the log cabin that holds a frozen prehistoric animal: a saber-toothed racoon. Softened, the Lemmings free the creature and try to tame it like a kitten. But the raccoon is like a whirlwind. Grizzy wakes up and discovers the cabin topsy-turvy and flies into a rage. But when the bear tries to kick the rodents out, the wild raccoon challenges him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: By chance, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a container filled with metal survival food flasks. Primarily filled with vegetables, they do not find favor with the bear, who is more interested in the hi-tech equipment at the rear of the container. Behind his back, the Lemmings find a flask of Yummy and skedaddle with it. But how will they escape Grizzy equipped with his sophisticated gear?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: In a trunk, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a big chocolate egg with a surprise inside. They are licking their lips. As they fight, they accidentally send the coveted egg flying amidst a group of penguins where a couple of winged creatures adopt it. They sit on the egg as if it were their offspring. Not intimidated, Grizzy and the Lemmings decide to get their hands on it, but the entire bird colony intervenes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings open a nightclub with blasting music and a disco ball in an igloo they have built not far from the cabin. The noise prevents Grizzy from sleeping. The bear confiscates the disco ball and propels the Lemmings far into the distance. They land in an ice cave where they discover a console that lights up the stars in the sky and controls the northern lights. The canopy of heaven starts blinking. The Lemmings transform the ice field into an open-air discotheque!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings come up with a ride worthy of a county fair in the living room. Awakened, Grizzy throws their juice extractor out the window and the rodents land in the neighboring science station where they accidentally wake up… a mammoth! A friendship is born between them. The Lemmings drag the mastodon into their game, and he transforms the entire cabin into a Ferris Wheel. Grizzy, who was trying to doze in peace, wakes up in a panic.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Before an audience of penguins and walruses, two teams of Lemmings perform acrobatic high jumps, competing for the winning prize. When Grizzy accidentally jumps in, he quickly gets caught up in the game and the clapometer goes wild! Intoxicated by his victory, the bear is by no means a modest winner! But the Lemmings want their moment of glory in the limelight as well!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While Grizzy fishes, a penguin comes over and sees that the bear's bucket is empty. He decides to help him and catches piles of fish. Impressed, the bear brings the penguin back to the cabin, where a friendship rapidly strikes up. This pleasant and friendly new companion quickly arouses the Lemmings' curiosity. They lure the penguin away on the sly and replace him with another one who's not nearly as clever. Grizzy will quickly see through the trickery.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy settles into the couch by the fireside, the Lemmings come charging into the living room on their new mount, the vacuum cleaner. Irritated, the bear throws the mechanical charger into the fireplace, which blows up. Freezing air sweeps into the cabin. Seeking a source of heat, Grizzy decides to move into the science station greenhouse where the temperature is controlled by a drone. But the bear is unaware of what he carries in his luggage: the Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a new playmate: a walrus! The rodents ride the creature throughout the cabin, then make him slide down the roof before starting all over again. Grizzy steps in and propels the creature to the back of a mysterious ice cave. In the center is a dolmen with a bone sitting on it. Whoever touches the bone becomes docile and prehistoric in appearance. The Lemmings dream up a scheme where Grizzy would submit to their will.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: When Grizzy goes fishing, the Lemmings jump on the opportunity to transform the cabin into a giant ice slide. Upon his return, the bear puts an end to the rodents' bobsleigh party and gets ready to savor his day's catch. But the Lemmings steal his fish and draw the bear outside the cabin. Grizzy must try to recover his lunch while protecting his territory from a rodent invasion.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy pinches a magic statue from the Lemmings that has the power to make objects appear in real life. All you have to do, is pin the photo of one's desires upon it. Too bad for the rodents' snow-bike! Grizzy replaces the vehicle's photo with the portrait of his beloved she-bear who stayed behind in Canada. Barely arrived in African, the she-bear disappears again, victim of the rodents' trickery. It is the outbreak of a bitter dispute.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys himself a DIY remote-controlled boat kit so he can compete in a race on the local pond. But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are at the cinema to see the three hour long “Romance In Paris”, which Mr Bean is not looking forward to. But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie – Zombie Aliens 3 – he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When a TV show offers cash to film in haunted homes, Mr Bean invites a film crew over and rigs his flat up to make it as spooky as possible – wobbly picture frames on wires, eerie noises on a tape recorder and a good old-fashioned sheet for a ghost. But will the tricks be convincing enough to win Mr Bean the money?

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side? Well, it's kind of tiring pretending to be someone you're not. Lamput learns an important lesson from a nearby blobby little girl. Be yourself, and if anyone's got a problem with that, they can go find their own patch of sand.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Moley and Dotty find themselves trapped inside Mishmosh’s lab when his state of the art security system is activated.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Hurley, a giant boisterous adventuring mole who boasts of dangerous stories, comes to town looking to drag Moley on one of his adventures! Frightened of being thought a coward, Moley tries to avoid him.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean cannot, for the life of him, place the face of the uninvited fat bloke on his doorstep. An old school photograph and school cap just about jog his memory. programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a crate of competition boomerangs. programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny uses his excavator to dig in this music video as he tackles looney jobs across town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s attempt to cut the grass is thwarted by a pesky root which refuses to budge. When Mr Bean breaks his spade he heads to the local Garden Centre to find a replacement. Its gardening gloves off when Mr Bean goes into battle with his rival green-fingered competitors.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Irma are off for a day at the seaside. Irma is travelling light but Bean wants to take almost everything his owns in an enormous trunk. Arriving at the seaside Bean’s trunk gets accidentally swapped with a trunk belonging to a famous stage magician. As Bean entertains Irma pulling rabbits out of hats the angry magician arrives on the scene - and he’s not a happy bunny.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Annoyed by the Lemmings' new magnetic train, Grizzy propels the whole lot of them far from the cabin. The rodents land in the neighboring hut of a sorcerer and a mysterious mask falls onto one of them, endowing him with the power of telekinesis. The Lemmings are thrilled! They return to the cabin to explore this new magic power. Perched upon pieces of furniture, they fly around the room to finish their life-size flying train game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy chases after the Lemmings, who have loaded a jar of Yummy into their remote-control driven car. Where the bear gets to the gas station, he destroys the vehicle and recovers the chocolate spread. The rodents find little mini-cars and chase Grizzy all the way back to the cabin, where they trip him up and intercept the coveted jar. Helpless, the bear sets out after them, until he runs into a tank truck filled with Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: To recover the jar of Yummy that Grizzy confiscated from them, the Lemmings decide to infest the bear's coat with fleas. The scheme works and Grizzy starts scratching himself frenetically. Nonetheless, the bear manages to counter their diversion and expulse the rodents. When they land on a sorcerer's hut, the Lemmings take possession of a magic scepter that has the ability to temporarily shrink objects. Now microscopic-sized, the rodents return to the cabin to get their paws on the chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy wakes up starving but the cupboards are empty. While the Lemmings play nearby with an elephant, the bear swipes their peanut reserves. Not at all pleased, the rodents decide to recover their bag of nuts and use the elephant's trunk like a powerful vacuum cleaner to hurl all sorts of objects at Grizzy. In the heat of the battle, the Lemmings discover a pack of fabulous peanut and chili pepper cookies that seem to make the pachyderm ultra-powerful.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy is about to start eating the last remaining food in the cabin: cocktail snacks. But the sly Lemmings get there first. A fight breaks out but is quickly cut short by the unexpected visit of a wart hog. The pig devours the crackers and then, using his snout, detects a forgotten old package of candy under the bed, which he also proceeds to gobble down. Everyone realizes that the creature has the ability to find food. Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over who will follow the beast to track down food.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: In order to win a trophy filled with Yummy candies, Grizzy and the Lemmings take part in a safari photo competition on an animal reserve. They must capture the portraits of a number of wild animals that live in the park. It requires all their cunning to approach the elephant, wart hog and bat and take photos for the contest. But when it comes to the super-speedy, blue-necked ostrich, it's a different kettle of fish!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While Grizzy organizes a picnic alongside the pond, the Lemmings steal his jar of Yummy using water balls to discreetly advance underwater. Despite their equipment, the bear surprises the Lemmings and traps the rodents inside a waterproof ball which he throws far into the distance. An ostrich mistakes the ball for her egg and sits on it, waiting for the egg to hatch. The Lemmings are adopted by this new mother who is prepared to do anything to satisfy her offspring!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Chased by a raging elephant, Grizzy and the Lemmings are ejected from the cabin and land on a small nearby promontory. One of the rodents finds himself seated upon a throne-shaped boulder. A ray of sunlight illuminates him, and the savannah animals bow down before the Lemming king! But as soon as he leaves his royal seat, his powers disappear. Grizzy grabs the opportunity to plop down on the throne. Upon his orders, the other animals seek to provide him with every comfort, bringing the cabin, television and food closer. But the Lemmings put their feet down.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy is brutally awakened by four Lemmings who are giving a grand percussion concert near the cabin, while the rest of the group dances to the rhythm. The grumpy bear puts an end to the festivities by propelling the Lemmings into the distance. When they land, they discover a magical djembe inside the trunk of a baobab tree. When the percussionists start playing again, the Lemmings and all the other wild animals are possessed by the demon of dance!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: In the midst of a heat wave, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the fridge. The rodents want to transform themselves into ice cubes to glide across their super curling ice slide, while Grizzy wishes merely to lie down inside the nice, cool appliance. After literally breaking the fridge in two, the Lemmings discover a container of refrigerant and create a new giant curling sheet in the savannah. But Grizzy has not given up the idea of resting in a cool spot!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy has gone all out for his dinner guest, the she-bear. But just as he is about to kiss her… Vroom! In the middle of a mad car race, the Lemmings wake him up with a jolt! Dragged out of his slumber and swept away upon a vehicle, Grizzy finishes the race in a daze. Not far away, the Lemmings find a mask that can control dreams. Once Grizzy gathers his wits, he wants only to get hold of the object and return to the she-bear of his dreams. But the Lemmings have other dreams, like high-powered racing cars.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy watches a documentary on salmon, whereas the Lemmings want to dance it up in the garage, nightclub style. TV versus music, the sonic war has begun! When a cloud passes overhead, Grizzy realizes that their respective gadgets run on electricity provided by solar panels. No more sun, no more electricity! He devises a plan whereby he will be the only one to access the energy, but the Lemmings have not said their last word!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: A confrontation between Grizzy and the Lemmings leads to a room in the castle tower. The bear accidentally sets off a mechanism and discovers a large medieval magic trunk.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: When the Lemmings spoil Grizzy's meal with their new game, the bear evicts them far from the cabin.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Eurojackpot
programme.desc: „Eurojackpot“ – populiariausia ir didžiausius laimėjimus Europoje siūlanti loterija, kuri vienija net 18-os šalių žaidėjus. Žaidimai vyksta du kartus per savaitę ir jų metu dalyviai turi galimybę laimėti 10–120 mln. eurų Jackpotą. Šalia jo tik žaidėjų Lietuvoje laukia ir papildomo žaidimo „Džokeris“ laimėjimai. Ši loterija daugybę mūsų tautiečių pavertė įspūdingų sumų laimėtojais, o keletą – net ir multimilijonieriais!

programme.title: Ar galiu užeiti?
programme.desc: Yra temų, kurios reikalauja išsamaus pokalbio. Šioje laidoje matysite interviu su įtakingais politikais, verslininkais ir visuomenininkais, išgirsite svarbias įžvalgas ir naujas įvykių detales. Laidoje dėmesys skiriamas visuomenę jaudinančioms, aktualioms temos ir pateikiamas platesnis suvokimo kampas. „Delfi interviu“ vedėja – patyrusi žurnalistė, ilgametė naujienų portalo redaktorė Rasa Lukaitytė-Vnarauskienė

programme.title: Baidare per Ameriką

programme.title: Kenoloto. Jėga
programme.desc: „Kenoloto“ – viena seniausių loterijų Lietuvoje, žaisti pradėta dar 1996 metais. Šiuo metu laimėjimus atnešantis kamuoliukai ridenami net tris kartus per dieną, o dalyviai patys gali rinktis, kelis iš jų bandys atspėti, savo laimingus skaičius bei bilieto kainą. Pastaroji prasideda nuo 0,25 Eur, o didžiausias galimas loterijos laimėjimas net 200 000 Eur!

programme.title: Vikinglotto
programme.desc: „Vikinglotto“ – pirmoji tarptautinė loterija Lietuvoje. Šiuo metu joje dalyvauja žaidėjai iš 10 šalių, kurie kiekvieną trečiadienį varžosi dėl 3–25 mln. eurų Aukso puodo. Ši loterija žaidėjus džiugina ne tik dideliais, bet ir ypač dažnais laimėjimais. Vienas iš jų – tik Lietuvai skirtas „5+1“ kategorijos prizas.

programme.title: Riešutėlių filmas
programme.desc: Šioje nuoširdžioje istorijoje sugrįžta Charlie Brown, Snoopy ir visa gauja. Charlie Brown įsimyli į kaimynystę atkeliavusią naują raudonplaukę. Jis vis bando padaryti naujajai mergaitei įspūdį ir gyvenimo tikslų siekia naujais būdais, tačiau kiekvieną sykį jaučia nusivylimą. Ar jam pasiseks užkariauti merginos širdį? Tuo tarpu, Snoopy stengiasi nukauti didžiausią savo priešą - Raudonąjį Baroną.

programme.title: Mozlis
programme.desc: Keistoje ir nepažįstamoje šalyje, viename ūkyje gyvenantys dramblūnai diena iš dienos tempia jungą. Tėvo Mozlio sunkią kasdienybę praskaidrina tik sūnelis Ru. Lakiodamas po ūkio apylinkes vieną dieną Ru aptinka seną paslaptingą urvą, ant kurio sienų – keisti piešiniai. Juose lyg ir pavaizduoti tokie patys dramblūnai kaip ir jis pats, bet viena detalė skiriasi. Ant uolų išpiešti dramblūnai stovi ant užpakalinių kojų, o į dangų tiesia ne drambliškas kanopas, o rankas! Susijaudinęs Ru viską papasakoja tėčiui ir Mozlis prisimena seną legendą, kuri byloja, kad kažkada seniai seniai dramblūnai išties vaikščiojo stačiomis! Atradimas neleidžia Mozliui ramiai gyventi ir jis nusprendžia sprukti iš ūkio. Pabėgę nuo pikto šeimininko, Mozlis ir Ru tikisi rasti paslaptingą miestą, kuriame vis dar gyvuoja dvikojų dramblūnų gentis.

Jie išvyksta į Niujorką, kai šis sudaro sutartį su stambia įrašų bendrove. Tačiau netrukus Deivas susipainioja naujai įgytos šlovės pinklėse ir nutolsta, palikdamas Gretą sudaužyta širdimi. programme.title: Velkami per betoną
programme.desc: Policininkai Bretas Ridžmenas ir Entonis Lurazetis (aktoriai Mel‘as Gibson‘as ir Vince‘as Vaughn‘as) karštakošiai cinikai, nevengiantys įžeidžiančių replikų kitos rasės, tautybės ir lyties asmenims bei sutariantys, kad jėgos panaudojimas negali būti per didelis ar netinkamas. Po vieno tokio jėgos panaudojimo paaiškėja, kad jis vis tik buvo netinkamas ir abu policininkai nušalinami nuo pareigų.Stokojantys grynųjų ir neturėdami kito pasirinkimo, šie du sugadinti kareiviai stačia galva panyra į nusikalstamą pasaulį, manydami, kad užsidirbs lengvų pinigų, tačiau tamsiausiuose šešėliuose atranda žymiai „daugiau“ nei kada nors tikėjosi.

programme.title: Diena po rytojaus
programme.desc: Siaubingi uraganai siaubia Los Andželą. Nematyta pūga siaubingai užgriūna Indiją. Greipfrutų dydžio kruša bombarduoja Tokiją. Niujorke temperatūra per vieną dieną svyruoja nuo kaitros iki stingdančio speigo. Netikėti staigūs klimato pokyčiai visame pasaulyje sukelia neregėto masto kataklizmus – žemės drebėjimus, milžiniškas potvynių bangas. Profesorius Edrienas Holas tyrinėja klimato pokyčius, kuriuos sukėlė pragaištingas „šiltnamio reiškinys“. Be to, jis privalo surasti ir išgelbėti savo sūnų, kartu su draugais įkalintą milžinišku ledo miestu virtusiame Niujorke. Prasidėjus nevaldomam visuotiniam bėgimui, herojus iškeliauja ten, iš kur visi trokšta kuo greičiau ištrūkti – į bekraštes ledo ir sniego platybes, netikėtai nusidriekusias ten, kur dar neseniai stūksojo modernūs didmiesčiai...

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Lahedad loomad
programme.desc: Alates surfavatest hiirtest ja maalivatest koertest kuni rääkivate hobuste ning trühvlisigadeni. Kõige kavalamad, nunnumad ja pöörasemad loomad.

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Noored kangelased
programme.desc: Põnev sari, kus lapsed võistlevad kahes suures väljakutses, mis on inspireeritud tõestisündinud kangelasteost.

programme.title: Andy metsikud seiklused
programme.desc: Andy ja Kipi metsikud seiklused viivad nad üle maailma veidrate ja imeliste loomade otsinguile.

programme.title: Hirmus ajalugu
programme.desc: See on energiline, üllatav ja tavapäratu kujutlus ajaloo kõige jubedamatest, kuid samas naljakamatest sündmustest. Muserdavatest maailmasõdadest ja kurvast keskajast võikate viikingite ning kihvtide kreeklasteni. Ajalugu pole kunagi olnud nii ulakas.

programme.title: Andy reisiseiklused
programme.desc: Andy, Jen ja Scout reisivad oma keskkonnasõbraliku masinaga mööda maailma ja avastavad looduse saladusi ning loomade uskumatut käitumist.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Briti parim noor pagar
programme.desc: Kuulsaima küpsetussaate variant noorte meistritega. 9 - 13aastased noored annavad endast kõik, et saada oma oskuste ja originaalsete retseptidega maa parimaks pagariks.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Loomade jutud
programme.desc: Lõbus ja hariv saade loomadest nii looduses kui koduaias. Igas osas saame teada huvitavaid ja üllatavaid tõsiasju ning mis kõige toredam, loomad ise räägivad endist...

programme.title: Joonistame koos: videomängud
programme.desc: Koomiksikunstnik Will Sliney näitab teile, kuidas joonistada imelisi videomängutegelasi! Olge valmis õppima hämmastavaid joonistamisoskusi.

programme.title: Loomaleksikon
programme.desc: Loomaleksikon viib nii lapsed kui ka pered teekonnale loomamaailma. Ookeani sügavustest kuni Aafrika südameni kohtuvad lapsed huvitavate, ainulaadsete ja põnevate loomadega, tutvudes nende elupaikade, ökosüsteemide, geograafia ja eriliste omadustega.

programme.title: Vasara Oksforde
programme.desc: Istorikė Nina Petersen atvyksta į Oksfordo universitetą skaityti paskaitos apie tremtį ir holokaustą. Daugiau nei prieš penkerius metus mergina čia studijavo ir šilti prisiminimai ją apgaubia vos įžengus. Čia ji sutinka ir buvusį doktorantūros vadovą, profesorių Tomasą. Studijų metais įsiliepsnoję jausmai ženkliai vyresniam vyriškiui vėl atgyja. Nina negali užgniaužti emocijų, nors puikiai žino, kad Tomasas yra vedęs. Viešnagės metu Nina susipažįsta su istorijos studentu Danieliumi. Ši pažintis pakreipia Ninos gyvenimą nauja linkme. Vaikinas prasitaria, kad jo močiutė – holokausto auka. Tad milžinišką žinių bagažą turinti Nina pažada padėti Danieliui išsiaiškinti močiutės tremties detales. Atversdami istorijos puslapius vieną po kito, jaunuoliai suartėja ir pamilsta vienas kitą. Ar Ninos jausmai Danieliui nugalės seną aistrą profesoriui?

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Vasara Salamankoje
programme.desc: Nikola ir Rikė – viena kitą mylinčios seserys. Ilgus metus jos laikosi tradicijos išvykti drauge į kelionę ir taip sutvirtinti savo bendrystę. Šį kartą geradarė Nikola joms suorganizuoja išvyką į Salamanką. Per savo išsiblaškymą ji pamiršta seseriai papasakoti, kad kelionė bus skirta savanorystei. Ir toli gražu neprimins poilsio ir ramybės ištaigingame viešbutyje. Sužinojusi, kad dvi savaites teks miegoti pakeleivingose užeigose ir lieti prakaitą atkuriant Šv. Jokūbo piligrimystės kelią į Kompostelą, Rikė ne juokais įsiunta. Juk ji svajojo apie pramogas ir šėliones, o ne darbą ir nuovargį. Vis tik kelio atgal nebėra ir merginos kimba į darbus. Visa laimė, vakare laukia gardi vakarienė užeigoje ir malonūs pokalbiai su kitais savanoriais. Vienos vakarienės metu seserys susipažįsta su užeigos šeimininko sūnumis. Netikėtai įsižiebia simpatijos kibirkštys.Ar pažintis su užeigos šeimininko sūnumis padės išsklaidyti Rikės nepasitenkinimą atostogomis. O gal abi seserys atras savo antrąsias puses čia, Ispanijoje?

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou
programme.desc: Nestokojant puikaus humoro čia kalbinami žymūs Lietuvos žmonės, netikėtais kampais atskleidžiant jų portretus. Justinas ir Mindaugas garantuoja, kad „Gero vakaro šou“ pokalbiai nebus nuobodūs, o svečiai kaskart sulauks labai netikėtų klausimų.

programme.title: Inspektorius Mažylis
programme.desc: Populiarus aktorius M. Jampolskis premjeroje atlieka pagrindinį – nedidelio miestelio policijos inspektoriaus Andriaus Mažylio – vaidmenį. Filme policininką visur lydi jo tarnybinis vokiečių aviganis, vardu Mažylis. Su šunimi į gimtąjį miestelį grįžęs dirbti Andrius po keleto metų, praleistų policijos akademijoje, randa labai pasikeitusią aplinką: dabar čia viską valdo nusikaltėliai ir korumpuoti vietos valdininkai. A. Mažyliui su bendravardžiu šunimi teks gerokai paplušėti, kad gimtinėje vėl viešpatautų tvarka ir ramybė. Filmo kūrėjai sako, kad šiame detektyve netrūks ir meilės istorijų, o siužetas bus įdomus visai šeimai: „Inspektoriaus Mažylio“ nuotykiai pasakojami su ironijos gaidele, humoristiniais pasisakymais, su šypsena žvelgiant į šviesiąsias gyvenimo puses.

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.

programme.title: Kas būtų, jeigu nebūtų Mėnulio
programme.desc: Kultinio režisieriaus Emilio Vėlyvio filmas įtrauks nuo pirmų akimirkų. Specialiųjų karinių pajėgų būrio smogikas Balys Stankus yra neabejotinai gabus snaiperis. Tačiau netikėtai nustatyta diagnozė išmuša jį ir jo artimuosius iš vėžių. Baliui nustatomas socialinio elgesio sutrikimas su vyraujančiu Aspergerio sindromu. Medikai rekomenduoja kariui užmegzti kuo artimesnius socialinius ryšius su jį supančia aplinka. Nepaprastos pastangos, stringanti savigyda ir kriminalinių nusikaltimų karuselė įsuka Balį į nežmoniškai pavojingą komiškų situacijų karuselę.

programme.desc: Nikola ir Rikė – viena kitą mylinčios seserys. Ilgus metus jos laikosi tradicijos išvykti drauge į kelionę ir taip sutvirtinti savo bendrystę. Šį kartą geradarė Nikola joms suorganizuoja išvyką į Salamanką. Per savo išsiblaškymą ji pamiršta seseriai papasakoti, kad kelionė bus skirta savanorystei. Ir toli gražu neprimins poilsio ir ramybės ištaigingame viešbutyje. Sužinojusi, kad dvi savaites teks miegoti pakeleivingose užeigose ir lieti prakaitą atkuriant Šv. programme.title: galvOK
programme.desc: Žaidimas „galvOK“ tapo linksmu šeštadienio įpročiu – žiūrovai kviečiami praleisti vakarą prasmingai, atsakinėjant į neįtikėtinus, keistus, o kartais ir labai juokingus klausimus. Tačiau šį rudenį projektas grįžta atsinaujinęs – prie ilgamečio kapitono Manto Katlerio prisijungs azartiškasis žaidimų fanas Mindaugas Stasiulis. Kartu su laidos svečiais jie bandys atsakyti į kuo daugiau klausimų, o už kiekvieną teisingą atsakymą laimėtus pinigus pasidalinti su už nugaros sėdėjusiais žiūrovais. Puiki nuotaika, jaudinanti įtampa ir smagus šeštadienio vakaras kaip ir visuomet – garantuotas!

programme.title: Angelas sargas
programme.desc: Šivradžas ir Rasal – vienas kitą mylintys brolis ir sesuo. Netekę mylimos mamos, vaikai užgauliojami bendraamžių ir engiami kaimynų. Brolis jaučia didelę atsakomybę apsaugoti mažąją sesutę, tad tampa tikru apsaugos skydu kasdieniuose iššūkiuose. Gyvenimas pasisuka dramatiškai, kai vaiku tėvas patenka į avariją ir susiduria su paslaptingos ginkluotos grupuotės nariais. Dabar vaikams teks dar labiau saugoti vienam kitą. Ar meilė ir ištikimybė padės išlikti kartu klastinguose gyvenimo posūkiuose? Ar blogo linkintys niekšai palauš vaikų pasitikėjimą vienas kitu?

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Vasara Toskanoje
programme.desc: Mados žurnalistė Laura gedi avarijoje žuvusios motinos. Tvarkydama mirusios motinos daiktus ji randa lėktuvo bilietą į Pizą ir viešbučio adresą. Mergina nusprendžia leistis į kelionę, kuri padėtų suprasti, kuo gyveno jos mama ir pas ką ji norėjo skristi. Atvykusi į Italiją Laura susitinka su mamos meilužiu Emanueliu. Pasirodo, jų romanas truko 25 metus! Laura jaučiasi sutrikusi. Ar gali būti, kad ji visiškai nepažinojo savo motinos? Kaip mama galėjo išduoti savo šeimą dėl meilės eiliniam italui? Emanuelio sūnus Alesandras pakviečia Laurą į savo šeimos vilą. Viešnagės metu Laura žingsnis po žingsnio artėja prie tiesos. Tuo pačiu, ji pradeda tyrimą apie aukštąją Italijos madą. Paaiškėja, kad net aukščiausios kokybės rūbai gaminami varganomis darbo sąlygomis. Žmonių išnaudojimas slepiasi net po brangiomis etiketėmis. Kokias dar paslaptis Laurai atskleis kelionė į Italiją? Ar ji sugebės atleisti mamai?
